claims: According to reports from the 2026 tournament, Rory McIlroy won his second consecutive green jacket.
According to reports from the 2026 tournament, Rory McIlroy became only the fourth golfer in history to win back-to-back Masters tournaments.
Rory McIlroy secured the 2026 Masters victory with a final-round 71.
Rory McIlroy finished the 2026 Masters at 12 under par.
Rory McIlroy defeated Scottie Scheffler in the 2026 Masters.
Rory McIlroy joins Jack Nicklaus, Nick Faldo, and Tiger Woods as a back-to-back Masters champion.
Reports indicate Rory McIlroy won the 2025 Masters.
Rory McIlroy has a total of six career major championships as of April 12, 2026.
